title: Browser runtime, personas and sign-in recovery
situations: Browser on an unconnected test host
Resettable machine must retain live logins
current: Authorize, verify and Browser QA share one omission rule: a missing identity uses default only when default declares sites or no identity declares sites. Otherwise they refuse browser_identity_required, name the choices, and require --identity or method_config.browser_identity. Explicit default stays anonymous. Mission dispatch uses explicit case personas or project identities covering the target origin. Source tests cover selection; live sign-in proof remains required.
questions: Live identity persistence and individual site probes were not exercised; current docs/CLI contract, not a sign-in guarantee.
